newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Eight Timorese to leave for Portugal next week.
newsitem.headline: Eight Timorese to leave for Portugal next week.

text.p: A second group of eight East Timorese who entered the French Embassy in Jakarta seeking political asylum are due to leave for Portugal next week, a diplomatic source said on Friday.
"The eight East Timorese will leave very probably on Monday. They will travel to Portugal," said the source.
The East Timorese entered the embassy before dawn on Thursday, raising to 16 the number of people from the troubled territory who have broken into the mission this week.
The first group of youths entered the embassy afer scaling the fence early on Tuesday. They left for Portugal on Thursday.
Since September 1995, 100 East Timorese have entered foreign embassies in Jakarta and been granted asylum in Portugal.
The United Nations does not recognise Indonesia's 1976 annexation of East Timor and regards Portugal, the former colonial ruler, as the administering power in the territory.
Jakarta has allowed asylum seekers to leave for Portugal with the help of the International Committee of the Red Cross.
